correctness.rationale: Under ordinary power domination in L(K_n), after the closed-neighborhood step precisely edges of K_U, where U is the isolated-vertex set of the selected K_n edges, remain unobserved. For |U|=2 a single forcing event completes; |U|>=3 leaves every observed edge with 0 or at least 2 unobserved neighbors, so no force. This proves iff |U|<=2. Inclusion-exclusion over exact isolated vertices proves complete polynomial; deleting a selected edge can create at most two new isolates, forcing the minimal sets to be an i=1 matching or i=2 star forest. Standard matching and exponential-formula enumerations give min/max and full minimal enumerators. Independent original graph monitoring closure, polynomial counts, minimal sets, maximal-failure counts verified for n=3..6 including 32768 selections at n=6; proof covers every n>=3.
